title: Gauge Unification & Supersymmetry Equation Audit
scope: Equations introduced in the SU(4)/SU(5)/Spin(10)/supersymmetry branch and their compatibility with the repository's Standard Model and RG conventions.

audit_results.notes: Repository uses Y equal to half the hypercharge used in conventions where Q=T3+Y/2. All new equations are normalized to Q=T3+Y unless explicitly noted.
Correct subgroup structure up to the usual global quotient details.

Correct for physical right-handed fields with Q=T3L+Y. If all fermions are represented as left-chiral conjugates, T3R can enter with opposite sign depending on representation convention. Archive now requires convention metadata.
Compatible with repository Q=T3+Y convention for the fundamental generator; conjugate representations reverse eigenvalue signs as expected.
Standard SU(5) matter embedding; ν_R is an SU(5) singlet.
Correct chiral spinor organization; use Spin(10) when discussing spinor representations, although SO(10) is conventional shorthand in phenomenology.
Standard 4D N=1 super-Poincare relation in common normalization.
Valid schematic grammar only; a physical model must specify Φ, its representation, potential, vacuum and stabilizer subgroup H.
One-loop form is correct when b_i includes the convention-dependent sign. Some texts define β(g)=-(b/16π²)g³ instead. Store the coefficient convention whenever numerical b_i values are added.
Follows from the previous convention α_i=g_i²/(4π).
Product-space shorthand; warped/fibered compactifications require more general geometry.
Standard warped-product ansatz form; exact powers/warp factors are model dependent.

integration_rules: Retain Q=T3+Y as the repository-wide electroweak convention unless a source uses another normalization.
Every U(1) equation must record normalization before comparing generators or running couplings.
Record right-handed versus all-left-chiral field conventions in Pati-Salam and GUT representation tables.
Use Spin(10) for mathematically precise spinor-representation statements; SO(10) may remain a search alias and phenomenology label.
Do not treat a schematic symmetry-breaking arrow as a complete Lagrangian or dynamical theory.
Do not infer supersymmetry from ordinary gauge-group enlargement. Gauge unification and SUSY are linked research branches, not the same symmetry.
external_audit_sources: Pati-Salam literature for SU(4)_C×SU(2)_L×SU(2)_R and Q=T3L+T3R+(B-L)/2
Georgi-Glashow SU(5) literature for 5bar⊕10 matter embedding and 24 adjoint
11D supergravity literature for G4=dC3 and 4D N=1/G2 compactification context
result: All core equations pass at schematic/algebraic level after adding explicit convention controls for Pati-Salam hypercharge and beta-function signs.
